scope: Only explicitly logged round2-4 AI company aid, classified as industry. Subtract from recorded nonIncomeGain to separate exogenous grants from other in-game acquisitions. Not total AI advantage: setup cards/income choices, launch/scan/research discounts, free probes and free actions are not monetized here. Synthetic inference stays in otherNonIncome, not assigned as aid. Human existing resource tables remain unmatched historical comparisons.
